concepts.why: The answer fills the update as max = i, which stores the position i instead of the element a[i], so it treats the index as if it were the stored value.
It declares max with a type and gives it a value before the loop reads it, but it gives no trace of how max changes.
Both assignments are written correctly with a single variable on the left, but there is no reasoning about evaluation. The wrong value in max = i is an indexing error, not an assignment error.
The answer uses a 1-D array and says nothing about row-major or column-major order.
